important_repairs: Immutable build-time parameter name/identity/version baseline across captures; all-model and exposed-global forward/pre-hook rejection; vision eager; provider operation callability.
retained_limits: Injected providers are unauthenticated; actual run must pin and verify real provider/source/runtime/snapshot identities before invoking factory.
Version counters do not detect deliberate raw-storage writes bypassing the counter; no cryptographic memory-integrity claim.
Public coverage/parameters/loading_report/provenance attributes are mutable informational metadata, not security evidence.
An exposed but malformed global-hook API can omit registries; actual runtime owner must use the verified real torch module surface, not a substitute.
Provider operation callability does not authenticate its semantics. Remaining low-severity review findings retained, no repeated repair loop.
